items.TITLE: PAW Patrol Birthday Clipart Bundle, 61 SVG Files for Invitations, Cupcake Toppers and Party Tags
items.DESCRIPTION:
Give your birthday party a matching PAW Patrol theme, from the first invitation to the last party bag. This digital clipart bundle includes 61 SVG files, with artwork featuring Chase in his police uniform, Marshall in his rescue gear, Ryder and a blue-outlined dog bone with room for a name.

Use Chase on the invitation, add Marshall to cupcake toppers, or place each guest’s name inside the dog bone to make personalised favour tags.

What you’ll receive
- 61 individual SVG files delivered digitally
- Full-colour character artwork and themed graphics
- Artwork you can place in invitations, birthday cards, party signs and print-at-home decorations
How to use the files

Open your chosen SVG in a design program that supports SVG imports. Place the artwork on your layout, add your party wording, then print or export your finished design. The sampled SVGs contain embedded images, so these files are best suited to printable projects. Check the detail at your intended print size.
